entities.name: UniProt A1VE74
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Nitratidesulfovibrio vulgaris proline--tRNA ligase.
Catalyzes proline activation by ATP followed by transfer to tRNA(Pro); EC 6.1.1.15, Rhea RHEA:14305.
Participates in prolyl-tRNA aminoacylation and translation; annotation includes editing of Ala-AMP and Ala-tRNA(Pro).
